1. (Currently Amended) A control system comprising: a controller including a processor and a memory, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by generating holistic state data, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, a model configured to describe the process used by the controller; determining, using the processor, input and output variables of the process; determining, using the processor, constraints on the input and output variables; determining, using the processor, an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and storing, in the memory, the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data, wherein the holistic state data comprises a data structure that is transmitted to the automation components to control operation of the automation components in performing the process.

2. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to communicate the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network, wherein the holistic state data is transmitted as a standardized data packet.

3. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane interface and to communicate the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane, wherein the backplane comprises a physical connection medium for transmitting the holistic state data.

4. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components, wherein the standardized format comprises predefined fields corresponding to the model, input and output variables, constraints, and objective function.

5. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, an intermediate search result of an optimization search; determining, using the processor, a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and storing, in the memory, the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data.

6. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system, wherein the optimization search comprises iterative evaluation of the objective function subject to the constraints.

7. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: determining, using the processor, computational capabilities of the controller; determining, using the processor, interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and storing, in the memory, the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data.

8. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data to a server in the control system via the communication network to facilitate determining an optimization problem, wherein the server comprises a computing device configured to receive and process the holistic state data.

9. (Currently Amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises the memory configured as an in-memory database to store the holistic state data, wherein the in-memory database is configured to provide rapid access to the holistic state data for transmission to the automation components.

10. (Currently Amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data from a data source; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data, wherein the characteristics comprise operational parameters and capabilities of each automation component; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components, wherein the optimization problem comprises an objective function and constraints derived from the operational parameters; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on solving the optimization problem, and wherein the control action comprises a specific command transmitted to the automation components to modify their operation.

11. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components, wherein the model comprises a mathematical representation of the automation component's behavior.

12. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing compatibilities of each of the automation components, wherein the computing capability comprises processing speed and memory capacity.

13. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components, wherein each holistic state data comprises a data structure containing the operational parameters and capabilities of the corresponding automation component.

14. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data, wherein parsing comprises extracting the operational parameters and capabilities from each holistic state data structure.

15. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields, wherein the standardized format enables consistent interpretation of the holistic state data across different automation components.

16. (Currently Amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud computing system via a network connection, wherein the cloud computing system comprises a remote server storing the control system configuration data.

17. (Currently Amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data comprises a data structure containing a model, input and output variables, constraints, and an objective function; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations, wherein simulating comprises executing the model using the processor to predict controller behavior; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller, wherein analyzing comprises comparing simulated behavior with expected behavior; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics, wherein adjusting comprises modifying parameters of the controller or automation components.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller, wherein the various control actions comprise different commands that the controller could issue; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions, wherein the results comprise predicted outcomes of executing each control action.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining, using the processor, a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using the model; and comparing, using the processor, the predicted response with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model, wherein the actual response comprises measured behavior of the control system.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting, using the processor, the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary by a threshold amount, wherein adjusting comprises modifying parameters of the model to improve accuracy.
